packageRules.description: Everything non-breaking lands in a single PR, across every manager. Grouping across managers is deliberate: the Bun and Playwright versions are each duplicated in package.json, CI workflows, the Dockerfile and .gitlab-ci.yml, and they only stay consistent if one PR moves all copies together. That holds only for copies a manager actually discovers — the two customManagers below cover the Bun pins, and the bun/github-actions/gitlabci managers cover the Playwright ones. A hand-pin somewhere none of them read is invisible here and drifts silently.
Majors land in a second, separate PR. They are the ones that need reading, so they never ride along with the routine bumps.

The db-isolation services stay on TimescaleDB 2.27.1 because the root-heap migration fixture cannot be created on 2.28.0 or later. Production Compose and the Testcontainers runtime pin still update together through the custom manager below.

BullMQ >= 5.58.7 rejects ':' in custom job ids. The worker's single-execution guarantee is jobId coalescing over colon-delimited keys (tick:<profileId>:<symbol>, backtest:<runId>), and the repo runs no distributed locks, so adopting a newer BullMQ means redesigning that key scheme first. Verified: 5.58.6 passes the worker integration suite, 5.58.7+ fails it.
@hono/zod-openapi 1.5.2 omits the zodModule import from its published declarations, which collapses schema inference to any.

customManagers.description: Bun runtime pinned as a build arg in the app image.

Bun runtime pinned in the GitHub Actions workflow env blocks (fed to oven-sh/setup-bun) and in the GitLab CI variables block. Both CI systems must move together, and GitLab quotes the value where GitHub does not, hence the optional quotes.
TimescaleDB runtime pinned in the Testcontainers wrapper. This copy moves with production Compose, while the separately named root-heap migration pin remains fixed.
